svg.desc: Left: a broadcast hash join copies the small items table to every partition of the big impressions table, so the big side is never shuffled. Right: a shuffle hash join repartitions both big tables by hash of the key, so both cross the network and a hot key produces one huge partition.

svg.text: Small side → broadcast it. Both large → shuffle hash or sort-merge. Skewed side → aggregate first.
